notes: Microsoft publishes no dimensions, mass or complete control list for this controller on any page found. The Computer History Museum record 102718656 («Xbox 360 wireless controller», 2005) prints «6w x 2 1/4h x 4 1/2l (in)» / «15.24w x 5.72h x 11.43l (cm)» and «1 (lb)», but it also carries a retail barcode as an identifying number and does not say whether the controller was measured bare or in its packaging, so the envelope is not filed (brief: confirm bare device); the mass is whole pounds (never used). Every value is null; the host platform key would be microsoft-xbox-360.
